devices: Available for iPhone, iPad and Android. Check the linked store for your device’s current compatibility.
price: Free to download. Check current store availability and purchase terms; free download does not establish that every feature is always free.
accounts: Local Scorekeeper scoring can start without an account. Courtside player tracking and other connected features require registration. FanView viewers and broadcasters need a registered account.
sharing: FanView opens in a browser without installing CourtsideView. Publishing and receiving live updates require internet. Live video is optional and needs someone broadcasting.
expiry: The same FanView link stays with the game and expires 15 minutes after the game concludes. It is not a permanent replay archive.
official: For official scorer duties, use the system and training your event requires. A family scoring app does not automatically replace the event’s official scoresheet.
